test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported (or indirect) speech.

Mohan said to Hari, “I will study for the exam.”

options.text: Mohan told Hari that he would study for the exam.
Mohan suggested Hari that he would study for the exam.
Mohan said to Hari that he will study for the exam.
Mahon would say to Hari that he will study for the exam.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
